description: Fixed showcase set for GEMM recognition: the hundred (80 positive cases, case_001..080, that the specification requires to be recognized, partitioned, lowered and offloaded by systolic-cc; 20 negative cases, case_081..100, not accepted by the compiler at 6e25528, each stating whether it is nevertheless a mathematically valid GEMM), the extended cases (ext_*), the boundary cases added after the hundred (case_101.., in the set their specification puts them in) and MLIR-level cases (mlir_*, recognition + partition + lowering only, nothing executed). 'expected' is the specification; 'current_implementation' the prediction from the compiler's sources; 'tested' is always false here -- actual results are written by scripts/run_showcase.py to reports/, never into this file. A negative-set case whose issue was fixed since (case_094, ISSUE-001) stays in its directory: files are never moved.

stage_vocabulary.frontend: systolic-cfront: translated | rejected (outside the affine C subset)
stage_vocabulary.recognition: recognizeLogicalMatmul: accept | reject (hoisting_required: the lowering pass must first move a repetition loop outward)
stage_vocabulary.lowering: --affine-matmul-to-systolic (bounds, aliasing, rank, exact partition): supported | unsupported | not_reached
stage_vocabulary.runtime: what the compiled program's own check must show
